name: News API AI
tagline: Semantic news search, event clustering, and concept extraction by Event Registry.
description: Event Registry's developer API for searching news articles, detecting and clustering world events, extracting concepts and entities, and retrieving structured news analytics. Provides semantic search over a large multilingual news corpus with filtering by source, language, category, and time.

auth.details: API key via apiKey query parameter or header; self-serve signup on newsapi.ai

use_cases: search recent news articles by keyword or concept
detect and list clustered world events
extract entities and concepts from news text
filter news by source, language, or category
